column1: # Rift Apart materials matched by hand to this game's textures (PLAN 9.2, docs/HANDOVER.md "Matching"): names only, nothing of Rift Apart's.
# Read by scripts/riftapart-pair.py write. Wave 1 (15 November 2026): the world textures of the three test frames (Veldin L01, Florana L02, level 23) with 500+ pixels.
# Wave 1b (15 November 2026): the 73 rows of wave 1 that barely showed in the game (painted steels, metal detail normals) or laid leaf atlases on plants, matched again from crops of the drawn frames.
# Wave 2 (15 November 2026): every level's world textures above 1% of its gameplay picture not yet matched (the vid-comic levels' own left for their class).
# Wave 2's one row its batch left out, matched by the main session.
# Props and shrubs (objects1, 15 November 2026): the mobies' and shrubs' textures above 0.2% of a level's picture (characters flagged for the regions' pass).
# Wave 3 (15 November 2026): every level's world textures between 0.2% and 1% of its gameplay picture.

# Props and shrubs on every level (objects2, 15 November 2026): every texture the levels load for their objects, triaged, the same picture matched once (its copies take its row), tile_m xN where no frame measured a repeat.

# metal1 (15 November 2026): the world's metal (1,058 textures on paint and metal materials, and their copies) re-matched by Sonnet agents for varied metalness, roughness and shine (captures/rift/matches/BRIEF-metal1.md): bare polished, brushed, dull and dark steels, grates, yellow metals, clean and worn painted metal, rust; not metal kept.

# props2 (15 November 2026): every prop texture no wave had matched (2,030, the vid-comic levels' own left out), sorted by Sonnet agents from contact sheets (captures/rift/matches/BRIEF-props2.md): surfaces and glass matched, leaves the derived leaf surface (scripts/riftapart-derive.py), lights flagged light (they glow: lights.tsv), water flagged water, characters flagged character, the rest none.
